name: Vasilisa
source:
Vasilisa is an employee of "Pomidorochka" supermarket branch, where Slava gets a job. A shy girl with hearing loss. She interacts with colleagues and clients using his phone; because of her daydreaming and absent-mindedness, she often gets into trouble.

Since childhood, she has been attending events from the All—Russian Society of the Deaf. Thanks to them, she has seen many cultural places and early became imbued with a love of painting.

She strives to live a full life and tries to do everything in her power for this.
